definitions.explanation: The single reproductive female of a bee colony, which lays the eggs and around which the hive is organized. Also used figuratively for a dominant woman at the center of a group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女王蜂|じょおうばち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一匹|いっぴき}→一匹：08930_ippiki⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There is one queen bee in the hive.

examples.japanese: {女王蜂|じょおうばち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{産|う}む→産む：01899_umu⟧⟦{役目|やくめ}→役目：00423_yakume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The queen bee has the role of laying eggs.

examples.japanese: {女王蜂|じょおうばち}がいなくなる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{巣|す}→巣：02140_su⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the queen bee is gone, the whole hive falls into disorder.

notes:
The reproductive female that heads a bee colony. Formed from ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧ (queen) + ⟦{蜂|はち}→蜂：02242_hachi⟧ (bee), with rendaku turning はち into ばち.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女王蜂|じょおうばち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{産|う}む→産む：01899_umu⟧: the queen bee lays eggs
- {女王蜂|じょおうばち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧にした⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: a colony centered on the queen bee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち}→働き蜂：29898_hatarakibachi⟧: worker bee — a non-reproductive female that gathers food and tends the hive
